Choose us for graduations, birthdays, bridal showers, weddings, baby showers, corporate parties, memorials, faculty receptions, cocktail parties, photoshoots, holiday parties, game day feasts, and more. SALADS Pasta Salad Pasta, Olive Oil, Cherry Tomato, Imported Pecorino Romano, Basil, Garlic, Spinach, Drizzle of Balsamic Vinegar. Insalata Ricca Romaine lettuce, Iceberg, Fresh Mozzarella, Baby Spinach, Sunflower Seeds, Diced Apple, Corn, Crispy Bacon, Burrata Cheese, Mozzarella, Served with toasted bread. Caprese Burrata & Rucola Burrata Cheese, Cherry Tomatoes, Basil, Arugula. Served with Toasted Bread, Extra Virgin Olive Oil & Balsamic Vinegar Glaze. MAIN COURSE Large Portions Risotto Funghi e Salsiccia Arborio rice, meat broth, sausage, mushrooms, mascarpone cheese, imported Parmigiana Reggiano. Gluten-Free Risotto Amatriciana Arborio rice, meat broth, tomato sauce, bacon, & imported parmigiana reggiano, imported pecorino romano. Gluten-Free Lasagna Bolognese Fresh pasta layers dressed with our bolognese beef sauce, bechamel sauce, olive oil, imported Parmigiano Reggiano, mozzarella. Penne Alfredo Fresh homemade pasta with rich and velvety Alfredo sauce, made with fresh cream, butter, and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese. Gnocchi Sorrentina Tomato sauce, basil, mozzarella, and imported Parmigiano Reggiano. Ricotta & Spinach Ravioli Fresh pasta filled with fresh ricotta cheese and spinach. MEATS Meatballs Delicious, all-beef Italian meatballs made with authentic ingredients. grilled chicken Tender Grilled Chicken Breast bites combined with our original Alfredo sauce. DESSERT Profiteroles Choux Pastry Balls filled with Cream & served with Dark Chocolate Sauce.
